Authoritative, audited figures.

(accelerant) for total consideration of $ 23.8 million, and the acquisition of the technology assets of analog design automation, inc. (ada) for total consideration of $ 12.2 million. The company acquired accelerant in order to enhance the company 's standards-based ip solutions. As of october 31, 2006 the company has paid substantially all the costs related to these acquisitions.
